facts.fact: The document states the Gambia implemented its second national strategy for the development of statistics, NSDS II 2018-2022, which has since come to term.

NSDS III 2024-28 was technically approved on 13 September 2023 by the national statistical system after a validation workshop in Banjul, and was submitted for endorsement by the National Statistics Council and Cabinet.
A mid-term evaluation of NSDS II 2018-2022 was carried out remotely with PARIS21 support from November 2020 to January 2021, with recommendations for the remaining period.
A final evaluation of NSDS II 2018-2022 was undertaken in July 2022 with PARIS21 support, and its report was presented and validated at a national workshop on 13-15 February 2023.
